headline: Computer Science PhD Student | AI Systems for Distributed Systems & Networking | Backend Engineering
summary: I’m Nieb Hasan Neom, a Computer Science PhD student and Kummer Doctoral Fellow building AI systems for distributed systems and networking. My work combines guarded LLM orchestration and agent-driven data movement with three years of backend engineering.
about: I build AI systems for distributed infrastructure: guarded LLM workflows, telemetry-driven data movement, and reproducible systems evaluation. My approach comes from both research and production backend engineering, so I treat constraints, failure modes, and operational evidence as part of the design—not as cleanup after a model works.
